verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a cloud identity service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a command-line tool for Entra ID. Microsoft Graph's REST API and metadata are developer building blocks, Graph Explorer is a web console rather than a CLI, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so none of these count toward this one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
